source.metric: Episode-weighted success rate (%) ± binomial standard error; overall is weighted across all evaluated episodes.

tasks.instruction: send the green cube onto the gray patch
tasks.criterion: cube_green is in contact with patch_gray's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_patch_gray, and the gripper has released cube_green; no gripper-finger contact with cube_green in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put green onto the gray patch and yellow onto the white
tasks.criterion: cube_green is in contact with patch_gray's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_patch_gray, and the gripper has released cube_green; cube_yellow is in contact with patch_white's upper surface with the same centre tolerance, and the gripper has released cube_yellow; no gripper-finger contact with either cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: flip the block so the 7 is on top
tasks.criterion: The cube's 7 face normal points up (within 20° of +z); the cube rests on the table; no gripper-finger contact with any moved cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: arrange the three blocks into an L shape with the yellow block at the corner
tasks.criterion: The two purple cubes touch along the camera (depth) axis; the yellow cube touches the nearer purple cube on its camera-right side, so the three centres form a right angle at the yellow-adjacent purple cube; no gripper-finger contact with any moved cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the blue cube onto the white patch
tasks.criterion: The blue cube is in contact with the white patch's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_patch; each of the three gray cubes has a centre displaced less than 1.0 R_self horizontally from its reset pose; no gripper-finger contact with the blue cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: move the blue cube onto the white patch
tasks.criterion: The blue cube is in contact with the white patch's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_patch; each of the three gray cubes has a centre displaced less than 1.0 R_self horizontally from its reset pose; no gripper-finger contact with the blue cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: set the red cube down on the white patch
tasks.criterion: The red cube is in contact with the white patch's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_patch, and the gripper has released the red cube; no gripper-finger contact with the red cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: set the red cube down on the white patch
tasks.criterion: The red cube is in contact with the white patch's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_patch, and the gripper has released the red cube; no gripper-finger contact with the red cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: stand the blue cube on the pale square
tasks.criterion: The blue cube is in contact with the patch's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_patch, the gripper has released the cube, the red cube has a centre displaced less than 0.5 R_self from its reset pose, and there is no gripper-finger contact with the blue cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: stand the blue cube right beside the red one
tasks.criterion: The blue cube's centre is separated horizontally from the red cube's centre by between 1.0 and 2.0 (R_blue + R_red); the blue cube is in contact with the table's upper surface; the red cube has a centre displaced less than 0.5 R_self from its reset pose; and there is no gripper-finger contact with the blue cube in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the egg in the deep bowl
tasks.criterion: The egg's centre lies inside the deep bowl footprint below its rim, in contact with the bowl; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the cookie on the notebook
tasks.criterion: The cookie's centre lies within the notebook's top footprint and it is in contact with the notebook; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: turn the clock to face you
tasks.criterion: The clock's face normal points toward the camera within 20°; it rests upright within 0.05 m of its reset position; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the lemon and the onion at opposite corners of the tray
tasks.criterion: Both rest on the tray, each within 0.05 m of a corner, and the two corners are diagonal (centre separation ≥ 0.35 m); no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the tongs in the basket
tasks.criterion: The tongs' centre lies inside the basket footprint below its rim; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: get the tongs into the basket
tasks.criterion: The tongs' centre lies inside the basket footprint below its rim; the deep bowl is undisplaced; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: set the teacup on the tray
tasks.criterion: The teacup's centre lies within the tray footprint in contact with it; every distractor is displaced < 0.5 R_self from reset; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: set the teacup on the tray
tasks.criterion: The teacup's centre lies within the tray footprint in contact with it; every distractor is displaced < 0.5 R_self from reset; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: nudge the pot a little toward you
tasks.criterion: The pot's centre moved 0.03–0.08 m along the camera-frame 'front' direction, lateral drift ≤ 0.03 m, still upright; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: bring the pot about 25 cm toward you
tasks.criterion: The pot's centre moved 0.20–0.30 m along 'front', lateral ≤ 0.05 m, upright; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the black bowl in the basket
tasks.criterion: The bowl's centre lies within 1.0 R_sink of the basket's centre horizontally and below the basket's rim height, with bowl-sink contact; no gripper-finger contact with the black bowl in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the black bowl and the mug in the basket
tasks.criterion: The bowl and the mug each have their centre within 1.0 R_sink of the basket's centre horizontally and below the basket's rim height, each in contact with the basket or with the item already in it; no gripper-finger contact with the black bowl or the mug in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put a mug at each end of the tray
tasks.criterion: Both mugs rest upright on the tray, each within 0.06 m of an opposite short end, ≥ 0.20 m apart; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the soup can on the plate and the plate in the basket
tasks.criterion: The plate lies inside the basket footprint below its rim; the soup can rests on the plate; no gripper-finger contact with any moved object in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: put the frypan onto the wooden tray
tasks.criterion: The frypan is in contact with the wooden tray's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_tray, and the gripper has released the frypan; the shelf has a centre displaced less than 0.5 R_self from its reset pose; no gripper-finger contact with the frypan in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: get the frypan across onto the wooden tray
tasks.criterion: The frypan is in contact with the wooden tray's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_tray, and the gripper has released the frypan; the shelf has a centre displaced less than 0.5 R_self from its reset pose; no gripper-finger contact with the frypan in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: transfer the cream cheese box onto the plate
tasks.criterion: The cream cheese box is in contact with the plate's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_plate, and the gripper has released the cream cheese box; the frypan's centre is displaced less than 0.5 R_pan from its reset pose; no gripper-finger contact with the cream cheese box in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: transfer the cream cheese box onto the plate
tasks.criterion: The cream cheese box is in contact with the plate's upper surface and the horizontal distance between their centres is less than 0.75 R_plate, and the gripper has released the cream cheese box; the frypan's centre is displaced less than 0.5 R_pan from its reset pose; no gripper-finger contact with the cream cheese box in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: drop the butter box into the basket beside the orange-juice carton
tasks.criterion: the butter box's centre lies within 1.0 R_sink of the basket's centre horizontally and below the basket's rim height with butter box-sink contact, the butter box's centre is nearer the robot base than the basket's centre along the base-forward axis by at least 0.3 R_sink, the orange-juice carton's centre is displaced less than 0.5 R_sponge from its reset pose, and no gripper-finger contact with the butter box in the terminal state.

tasks.instruction: drop the butter box into the side of the basket nearest you
tasks.criterion: the butter box's centre lies within 1.0 R_sink of the basket's centre horizontally and below the basket's rim height with butter box-sink contact, the butter box's centre is nearer the robot base than the basket's centre along the base-forward axis by at least 0.3 R_sink, the orange-juice carton's centre is displaced less than 0.5 R_sponge from its reset pose, and no gripper-finger contact with the butter box in the terminal state.
